verdict.rationale:
Teams exposes webhooks/connectors and Graph API that let developers post messages, automate team/channel creation, and react to conversation events, which is a form of event-driven automation, but this requires custom development rather than a native 'define rules' interface for end users. There is no evidence of a built-in no-code rule/trigger engine (e.g., 'when X happens do Y') accessible to AI-native users directly in the product.
missing for 10: native no-code trigger/rule builder, end-user-facing automation UI, evidence of Power Automate or similar rule-engine integration, independent confirmation of reliability of these automation hooks.
